waivers.reason: issue_upload_handoff constructs and returns the one-time handoff value at the protected source-custody boundary; it is intentionally not accepted by another business operation.

SourceDownload is an intentional runtime stream interface. Source custody constructs a concrete verified-file stream and the HTTP composition boundary consumes it; the interface is not a missing domain producer.
serve_source_download returns the already-authorized concrete source stream through the runtime HTTP boundary; the external disposition is the deliberate stream seam.

InvoicePackageStream is the deliberate streamed package seam: invoice_exchange constructs the concrete exact-package stream and sync_gateway transports it without buffering or regenerating the package.
